name: Cooperation
body:
You know that you and your allies are strongest when you work together toward a common goal.

Associated Domain: Community.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the calming touch ability of the Community domain.

Synergistic Touch (Sp)

You can touch a creature as a standard action to confer upon it the benefits of any one Teamwork feat that you possess. This effect persists for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—borrow skill, 2nd—share language, 3rd—coordinated effort.
